changes: Added confirmed ID 1317 for LLM-Guided Program Evolution for Circle Packing: Breaking 10 Packomania Records for $28. The paper and Packomania report ten new best-known feasible variable-radius circle packings in a unit square, for N=101-103, 105-109, 111 and 114. This is a best-known-construction claim, not an optimality theorem. Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05093v1. Further checking: External Packomania acceptance and exact table values support the ten bounded best-known constructions; the row makes no optimality claim. No downloaded code or packing artifact was executed.
